S1.why: جا (slot, room) names the tiles as places, and the same word carries the room after unlocking in S6, S22 and S23.

S2.why: A polite imperative read as an invitation, which works whether the person has saved five items or none; no question, no limit word.

S3.s: هر %lld جای رایگان را پر کرده‌اید. کاتلینگ‌هایتان رایگان می‌مانند و مثل همیشه کار می‌کنند.
S3.back: every 5 place-of free (object) full you-have-made. Cutlings-your free stay and like always work do.
S3.why: Active and addressed to the person (پر کرده‌اید), then the reassurance in plain verbs; کاتلینگ‌هایتان is the vocabulary file's own possessive form.

S4.why: Persian keeps the noun singular after a number; «the first five are free» is how a Persian speaker states an allowance, with no «you can».

S5.s: %1$lld از %2$lld جای رایگان پر شده است
S5.back: 3 of 5 place-of free full become is
S5.why: «3 از 5» is the native count order; positional placeholders kept so the numbers cannot swap, and جا keeps the slot word from S1.

S6.why: A noun phrase for a bold row line, singular noun after the number, جا carried on from S1.

S7.s: تا %@ متن و %lld تصویر جا می‌گیرد
S7.back: up-to 5,000 text and 500 image room takes
S7.why: متن and تصویر are the vocabulary file's words for the two kinds (singular after a number); «جا می‌گیرد» (fits) keeps the room idea instead of a second save verb.

S8.why: Device names stay in Latin script as the vocabulary file writes Mac and Apple; Persian comma ، and و before the last item.

S9.s: یک خرید برای هر سه کافی است، با همان حساب Apple شما.
S9.back: one purchase for every three enough is, with same account-of Apple your.
S9.why: «هر سه» (all three) points back at the bold line above; «حساب Apple شما» is the vocabulary file's phrase for the Apple Account.

S10.why: Plain present tense describing what happens, which reads calmer at the payment moment than an imperative.

S11.s: بدون اشتراک، بدون تبلیغ و بدون ثبت‌نام
S11.back: without subscription, without advertisement and without sign-up
S11.why: Repeated بدون is how Persian app pages list what is absent; ثبت‌نام covers the account to sign up for in one word.

S12.why: The wording Persian-language iOS apps use for the App Store restore action.

S13.why: «در حال» is the native progress form for a status line; single ellipsis character.

S14.why: «نسخه‌ی کامل» (full version) is the native Persian name for an unlocked app and is used for every unlock key; «با» + price is how a price follows an action in Persian; paying once is said by S10 just above.

S15.why: S14 without the price, same words so the button does not change meaning when the price loads.

S16.why: The everyday polite way to put something off in Persian; it says later, not never.

S17.why: The verbal noun, which is how Persian labels a close button.

S18.why: «مال شماست» (it is yours) is warm and a little proud, and «همه‌چیز» takes in all the room the grid just showed.

S19.s: ممنون که خریدید. کاتلینگ را یک نفر می‌سازد و این خرید پشتش را گرم می‌کند.
S19.back: thanks that you-bought. Cutling (object) one person makes and this purchase his-back (object) warm makes.
S19.why: «پشت کسی را گرم کردن» is the native idiom for backing someone up; naming the one maker makes the thanks concrete.

S20.s: خوش برگشتید. خرید قبلی‌تان دوباره سر جایش است.
S20.back: well you-came-back. purchase-of earlier-your again at its-place is.
S20.why: «خوش برگشتید» is the spoken welcome back; «سر جایش است» (back where it belongs) is the idiom for something restored.

S21.s: %1$lld از %2$lld جای رایگان پر شده است
S21.back: 3 of 5 place-of free full become is
S21.why: Same sentence as S5 so VoiceOver says what the subtitle shows; reads naturally aloud.

S22.s: %lld کاتلینگ دارید و حالا جا برای %@ کاتلینگ هست.
S22.back: 5 Cutling you-have and now room for 5,000 Cutling there-is.
S22.why: Persian nouns stay singular after any number, so one form reads right for 1, 2, 5 and 21.

S23.s: نسخه‌ی کامل فعال شد. حالا جا برای %@ کاتلینگ دارید.
S23.back: version-of full active became. now room for 5,000 Cutling you-have.
S23.why: «فعال شد» is the short spoken confirmation; the second sentence carries the room, in the same words as S22.

S24.why: An impersonal intransitive verb: nothing and nobody is blamed.

S25.s: فعلاً App Store در دسترس نیست. کمی بعد دوباره امتحان کنید.
S25.back: for-now App Store in reach is-not. a-little later again try do.
S25.why: Starts with a Persian word so the right-to-left line is not led by Latin; «کمی بعد» says shortly without urgency.

S26.s: این خرید را App Store تأیید نکرد.
S26.back: this purchase (object) App Store confirm did-not.
S26.why: Object first is natural Persian word order, keeps the line from opening in Latin, and avoids a translated passive with «توسط».

S27.s: روی حساب Apple این دستگاه، خریدی از کاتلینگ پیدا نشد.
S27.back: on account-of Apple this device, a-purchase of Cutling found not-became.
S27.why: «this device's Apple Account» names the signed-in account in four words; «پیدا نشد» (not found) is calm and blames no one.

S28.s: نسخه‌ی رایگان %lld کاتلینگ جا دارد. با یک بار خرید نسخه‌ی کامل، هر چقدر بخواهید ذخیره کنید.
S28.back: version-of free 5 Cutling room has. with one time buying-of version-of full, every how-much you-want save do.
S28.why: «نسخه‌ی رایگان» pairs with «نسخه‌ی کامل» used everywhere else; «هر چقدر بخواهید» is the spoken «as many as you like».

S29.why: A compact count under the list title; the title above already says کاتلینگ‌ها, so the noun is left out.

K1.s: هر %lld جا پر شد؛ برای خرید بزنید
K1.back: every 5 place full became; for buying tap
K1.why: Fits one key-high line: «free» is dropped since the five places are the free ones, and «بزنید» is the everyday Persian verb for tapping.

M1.why: A verbal-noun command, like Persian Mac window titles, and the same words as the iPhone button.

M2.why: M1 as a button, with the ellipsis character because it opens a window.

M3.why: The plural of the S1 slot word, as a row label whose value is M4.

M4.why: «از» rather than a slash, because a slash between digits reads backwards in a right-to-left row.

M5.why: The same unlock name as everywhere else, as a status.

M6.s: با یک خرید، نسخه‌ی کامل روی iPhone، iPad و Mac فعال می‌شود.
M6.back: with one purchase, version-of full on iPhone, iPad and Mac active becomes.
M6.why: Device list written as in S8; «روی» is the preposition Persian uses for software on a device.

M7.s: نسخه‌ی کامل روی iPhone، iPad و Mac با این حساب Apple فعال است.
M7.back: version-of full on iPhone, iPad and Mac with this account-of Apple active is.
M7.why: Same frame as M6 in the present, «با این حساب Apple» for this Apple Account.

M8.s: کاتلینگ را پیش از آنکه رایگان شود خریدید، پس برایتان کامل می‌ماند. ممنون از همراهی‌تان.
M8.back: Cutling (object) before that free it-becomes you-bought, so for-you full stays. thanks for companionship-your.
M8.why: «ممنون از همراهی‌تان» (thanks for sticking with us) is the warm thanks Persian apps give long-time users; «کامل می‌ماند» keeps the full-version word.
